title: Kissed Caramelized American Freekeh Pilaf
description: A pescatarian-friendly dish featuring caramelized freekeh, with a winey and glassy-jelly texture, made in a kazan-cauldron, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kazan-cauldron over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the freekeh and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the freekeh is tender.
Add the shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until pink and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
